messages:
drift-bot: Alert: environment diff detected between eu-west-1-staging and eu-west-1-prod for cluster `rf-prod-eu`. Blocker: nodepool 'gpu-heavy' instanceType mismatch (staging: g5.x, prod: g5.2x) and missing NetworkPolicy 'allow-internal' in prod. Canary rollout blocked (503 from LB).

sam: saw this. Terraform plan shows an instance_type override got applied to staging during cost tests last week; looks like that override was accidentally promoted.

priya: how did that promotion happen? our gitops should refuse nodepool size/type changes without approval. :thinking_face:

josh: I did a quick helm values tweak in staging to validate GPU scheduling, but I didn't touch prod. suspicious that something auto-synced. don't merge anything until we reconcile.

maria: cost team warned that switching prod to g5.2x will ~2x hourly spend. we need a rollback option or scale count down immediately.

sam: I'm going to run the envsync reconcile job in dry-run to produce a patch preview. will include both node-sku rollback and netpol apply.

infra-bot: envsync job started: id=es-2141598765-1, target=rf-prod-eu, diffs=[node_sku, networkpolicy], mode=dry_run

sam: TF diff snippet from plan (trimmed):
```terraform
~ module.nodepool.aws_instance_type = "g5.2x" -> "g5.x"
~ module.nodepool.node_count = 8 -> 4
```

priya: netpol diff to apply in prod (weird it was missing):
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-internal
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector: {}
```

josh: if the dry-run looks safe, we should auto-generate a reconcile PR that includes a cost-ack label and a required approver. prevents accidental promos.

maria: agree. add finance approval gate for changes that increase per-hour compute > 1.5x in prod.

sam: @infra-bot run dry reconcile and output proposed PR body + diff.

infra-bot: reconcile dry-run complete. preview PR: "patch/nodepool-gpu-sku-rollback-2141598765"; changes: instanceType=g5.x, apply NetworkPolicy allow-internal, plan_ok=true, risks=[rolling-update, evict-gpu-pods]

sam: LGTM. I'll request manual approval from @maria and then apply.

maria: approved. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: reconcile applying: job_id=es-2141598765-1, status=applying, started=2141599050

infra-bot: reconcile applied: job_id=es-2141598765-1, status=applied, completed=2141599095. Rolling update started. Verifying load balancer annotations and pod readiness.

josh: monitoring GPU pods and LB health. will watch utilization and pod eviction logs for 1h.

sam: cost estimate after rollback ~48% lower monthly vs g5.2x config. saving noted.

maria: adding a runbook note and postmortem item: tighten gitops admission for node-sku and add explicit approver requirement in PR template.

priya: also file a follow-up to detect future missing netpols as a policy check before canary runs. :eyes:

infra-bot: follow-ups created: #3422 (gitops admission), #3423 (netpol preflight check)

sam: thanks everyone — keep an eye on any autoscaler oscillation over the next 24h.
